rule: SOURCE_CLAIM and OUR_RESULT are separate fields. OUR_RESULT is NOT_RUN for every candidate.
unknown_rule: UNKNOWN stays UNKNOWN. It is never rendered as 0.
evidence_precedence: Primary repository evidence (source, README, committed CSV, LICENSE) over any secondary summary.
